name: Reconciliation
overview: Scripture reveals reconciliation as a profound restoration of relationships, whether between individuals or between God and man. The tender reunion of Esau and Jacob, marked by embrace and tears, exemplifies personal forgiveness and restored fellowship. At the altar, blood sacrifices were instituted to make reconciliation, symbolizing God's provision for atonement and peace with Him. Ultimately, reconciliation encompasses the removal of sin and iniquity, as foretold in Daniel's prophecy, securing everlasting righteousness through God's gracious work.
